blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Proactive video assistants must decide not only what to say, but also when to speak. Existing reinforcement-learning objectives can reward timely, correct responses without accounting for response volume, thereby encouraging unnecessary or repeated emissions. We identify this failure mode in MMDuet2, whose proactive area-under-the-curve (PAUC) reward promotes timely responses but does not price the number of emissions. We show analytically that this makes additional responses weakly penalized or effectively free, systematically encouraging over-emission. We then propose an emission-aware F1 reward for interval-valued annotations, using exclusive span--emission matching to price false emissions and missed spans. Under MMDuet2's training recipe, our policy on the visual subset of OmniPro replies 2.5x less often than MMDuet2 while raising timing F1 from 0.259 to 0.396 and content-aware F1 from 0.103 to 0.154; a more conservative variant cuts replies by 82.5% and raises precision from 0.161 to 0.418. On ProactiveVideoQA, the same reward adds replies where the baseline is nearly silent, and PAUC ranks a heavily over-emitting policy second despite near-last F1, because it is insensitive to response count. Our results indicate that proactive assistants should be trained and evaluated with objectives that price emissions.
blocks.zh: 主动的视频助理不仅必须决定该说什么,而且还必须决定何时发言. 现有的强化学习目标可以奖励及时、正确的反应,而不考虑反应量,从而鼓励不必要的或重复的排放。 我们在MMDuet2中发现了这种失败模式,其积极的低曲线区域(PAUC)奖励有助于及时作出反应,但并不定价排放量。 我们从分析上表明,这使更多的反应受到微弱的处罚或有效自由,有系统地鼓励过度排放。 然后,我们提议对间隔值说明给予排放意识的F1奖励,采用排他性跨度排放与错误排放和漏掉的跨度价格相匹配。 在MMDuet2的训练食谱下,我们关于OmniPro的视觉子集回复2.5x的策略比MMDuet2的频率要少,同时将时间F1从0.259提高到0.396,内容意识F1从0.103提高到0.154;更保守的变种切答82.5%,精度从0.161提高到0.418. 在 " 积极主动的VideoQA " 上,同样的奖励在基线几乎无动于衷的情况下增加了答复,而PAUC将排放过大的政策排在第二位,尽管接近最后的F1,因为它对反应计数不敏感。 我们的结果表明,应对主动助手进行培训和评价,以达到价格排放的目标。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Video large language models (Video-LLMs) are increasingly moving from offline video understanding toward continuous streaming interaction, where frames arrive sequentially and the model must decide autonomously when to respond [ 2 , 14 , 12 ] . In such proactive systems, response timing is part of the prediction problem: speaking too late reduces utility, while speaking unnecessarily produces repetitive or unsupported responses. Because the assistant initiates these interactions without being prompted, each unnecessary reply consumes user attention, can distract from genuinely relevant events, and adds avoidable inference and communication overhead; repeated low-value replies can also erode user trust. We refer to each model-generated reply at a decision turn as an emission .
blocks.zh: 视频大语言模型(Video-LLMs)正日益从离线视频理解转向连续流互动,帧依次到达,模型必须自主决定何时响应[2,14,12]. 在这种积极主动的系统中,反应时间是预测问题的一部分:发言太迟会减少效用,而发言则不必要地产生重复或不支持的反应。 由于助手在没有被催促的情况下启动这些互动,每个不必要的回复会消耗用户的注意力,可以分散对真正相关的事件的注意力,并增加可避免的推论和通信间接费用;重复的低值回复也会侵蚀用户的信任. 我们在决定转弯时将每个模型生成的答复称为排放。

blocks.en: Recent systems have therefore begun learning when to speak rather than relying only on fixed inference thresholds. MMDuet2 [ 12 ] , for example, formulates response triggering as a per-turn textual decision and optimizes the policy using reinforcement learning. Despite improved timing performance, recent evaluation shows that proactive Video-LLMs can still achieve high temporal scores by responding frequently, increasing recall at the expense of precision [ 4 ] . This raises a fundamental question: does the learned policy over-emit because optimization fails, or because the reward itself makes frequent emission advantageous?
blocks.zh: 因此,最近的系统已开始学会何时说话,而不是仅仅依赖固定的推断阈值。 例如,MMDuet2 [12] 制定了作为每回合文字决定的触发反应,并利用强化学习来优化政策. 尽管时间性能有所改善,但最近的评价表明,积极主动的Video-LLMS仍然能够通过频繁的响应而达到较高的时间性分数,增加召回率而牺牲精度[4]. 这就提出了一个根本性的问题:所学政策是否因为优化失败而超额执行,还是因为奖励本身就使频繁的排放变得有利?

blocks.en: Figure 1: Overview of the proposed emission-aware reward design. Count-insensitive temporal rewards can favor repeated or unnecessary responses, whereas our interval-aware F1 formulation prices false emissions and missed spans through exclusive emission–span matching.
blocks.zh: 图1:拟议排放意识奖励设计概述。 计数不敏感的时间奖励可能有利于重复或不必要的反应,而我们的时间间隔-意识到的F1配方价格是虚假的,通过排他性排放-span匹配而漏掉。

blocks.en: We show that the latter can occur. In MMDuet2, the dominant Proactive Area Under the Curve (PAUC)-based reward integrates response quality over an annotated temporal span, rewarding early improvements but not explicitly accounting for the total number of emissions. An additional reply can therefore increase reward when it improves the running score, while costing nothing when it does not, and the auxiliary penalties for out-of-span and repetitive replies weaken as the number of decision turns grows. Section 3 characterizes these incentives and shows that over-emission becomes increasingly favorable when relevant events are sparse relative to decision opportunities.
blocks.zh: 我们显示,后者有可能发生。 在MMDuet2中,基于曲线(PAUC)的主导主动区在附加说明的时间内将反应质量综合起来,奖励早期改进,但没有明确计算排放总量。 因此,在提高运行得分时,额外的回复可以增加回报,而在不花费时则不付出任何代价,而对于散货外和重复回复的辅助处罚则随着决定数量的增加而减弱。 第3节说明了这些激励办法,并表明,在相关活动相对决策机会而言稀少的情况下,过度排放变得日益有利。

blocks.en: To address this mismatch, we propose an emission-aware F1 reward for interval-valued annotations that explicitly couples reward to the number of responses produced by the model. Our formulation uses one-to-one maximum-weight matching between emissions and gold spans, allowing each span to credit at most one reply while explicitly penalizing unmatched emissions and missed spans. As a result, an additional response must provide sufficient value to justify its cost rather than serving as a nearly free additional attempt. Our contributions are threefold: (1) an analytical diagnosis of how PAUC-based reward design can systematically incentivize over-emission; (2) an interval-aware, emission-priced F1 reward based on exclusive span–emission matching; and (3) an empirical evaluation showing an 82.5% reduction in emissions on OmniPro while raising precision from 0.161 to 0.418 and F1 from 0.259 to 0.346. Figure 1 contrasts the two reward structures.
blocks.zh: 为解决这一不匹配问题,我们提议对间隔值说明进行排放意识F1奖励,明确夫妇奖励模型产生的答复数量。 我们的表述采用排放量和黄金间的最大重量比对,允许每个间距最多一个答复,同时明确惩罚无法匹配的排放量和漏掉的间距。 因此,额外的反应必须提供足够的价值来证明它的费用是合理的,而不是作为几乎免费的额外尝试。 我们的贡献有三个:(1) 分析诊断基于PAUC的奖励设计如何系统地刺激过度排放;(2) 时间间隔、排放价格基于排他性跨度-排放比对的奖励;(3) 实证评估显示OmniPro的排放量下降了82.5%,同时精确度从0.161提高到0.418,F1从0.259提高到0.346。 图1对比了两个奖励结构.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Proactive streaming Video-LLMs. Streaming Video-LLMs must determine both response content and response timing [ 2 , 16 ] . Existing triggering mechanisms include token-driven decisions [ 2 , 18 , 3 ] , dedicated classification heads [ 14 , 8 , 11 ] , and heuristic visual or uncertainty criteria [ 15 , 17 ] . Recent methods increasingly learn this decision directly through reinforcement learning. MMDuet2 [ 12 ] , for example, formulates triggering as a per-turn textual decision optimized via RL, eliminating the need for fixed inference thresholds. We focus on the reward design for such learned response policies.
blocks.zh: 主动流动的Video-LLM. Streaming Video-LLM必须确定响应内容和响应时间[2,16]. 现有的触发机制包括象征性驱动的决定[2,18,3],专用分类头[14,8,11],以及Heuristic视觉或不确定性标准[15,17]. 最近的方法越来越多地通过强化学习直接学习这一决定。 例如,MMDuet2 [12] 提出触发,作为通过RL进行优化的每回合文本决定,从而不再需要固定推论阈值. 我们的重点是为这种学到的对策设计奖励办法。

blocks.en: Timing metrics and rewards. StreamingBench [ 6 ] and OVO-Bench [ 7 ] evaluate temporal correctness but score at most one response per query. ProactiveVideoQA [ 13 ] introduces PAUC, which integrates response quality over an annotated temporal span but does not explicitly account for the number of emitted responses. More recent benchmarks address over-triggering directly: OmniPro [ 19 ] penalizes unnecessary responses, while StreamPro-Bench [ 4 ] evaluates response trajectories using precision-recall F1. Correspondingly, MMDuet2 [ 12 ] optimizes a PAUC-derived reward that favors early, correct responses while adding penalties for repetition, out-of-span emissions, and verbose prefixes, whereas StreamPro [ 4 ] introduces a count-sensitive turn-level F1 term for timestamp-valued targets. Both score response content with an LLM judge [ 5 ] . In contrast, we analyze why count-insensitive temporal objectives favor over-emission and propose an emission-aware formulation for interval-valued annotations.
blocks.zh: 时间尺度和奖励。 流化奔驰[6]和OVO-奔驰[7]评价时间正确性,但每个查询最多得一个答复. 主动视频QA[13]引入了PAUC,它整合了附加说明的时间段内的反应质量,但没有明确说明所排放的答复的数量。 较近期的基准直接针对过度触发:OmniPro[19]惩罚不必要的响应,而StreamPro-Bench[4]则使用精确召回F1来评价响应轨迹. 相应的,MMDuet2[12]优化了PAUC衍生的奖励,该奖励有利于早期,正确的反应,同时增加了重复,散热排放,以及动词前缀的处罚,而StreamPro[4]则引入了一个计数敏感的回合级F1术语,用于时间戳值目标. 两种评分回复内容都与LLM评委[5]. 与此相反,我们分析为什么计数不敏感的时间目标偏爱过量排放,并提议对间隔值说明进行排放意识的表述。

blocks.en: 3 When Temporal Rewards Encourage Over-Emission
blocks.zh: 3 当临时奖励鼓励过度排放时

blocks.en:
We use MMDuet2 [ 12 ] as a representative case study
of RL-based proactive response timing. On the visual subset of OmniPro,
it produces 6,961 replies for 1,723 annotated triggers, motivating closer
inspection of the underlying objective. These excess emissions occur both
outside annotated events and as repeated responses within already-covered
spans. Rather than viewing this as a model-specific optimization failure,
we identify two broader structural incentives in count-insensitive temporal
objectives: additional predictions can carry little or no marginal cost,
and normalized penalties can weaken as the number of decision opportunities
increases.

blocks.en: 4 Emission-Aware Reward Design
blocks.zh: 4 排放-气体奖励设计

blocks.en:
Section 3 suggests a general design requirement: the marginal cost of speaking should depend directly on the number of responses produced by the policy. Reweighting count-insensitive terms alone cannot guarantee this property. A precision–recall formulation naturally provides it because its
prediction-side denominator grows with model output.
blocks.zh:
第3节提出了一般设计要求:发言的边际费用应直接取决于政策作出的答复数目。 仅仅重新加权不敏感的词语不能保证这种财产。 精确的-召回表述自然提供了它,因为它
预测-侧分母随模型输出增长.

Unlike point-timestamp supervision, interval-valued targets introduce an assignment problem because multiple emissions may fall within the same span and overlapping spans may compete for the same prediction. blocks.en: 4.1 Matching interval-valued annotations
blocks.zh: 4.1 匹配间隔值说明

blocks.en:
Interval-valued supervision introduces an assignment problem absent from point-based annotation. Multiple emissions may lie within a single span,
while overlapping spans can make one emission eligible for several
spans. Crediting every eligible pair would again reward
over-generation, whereas greedy matching can consume an emission needed
to cover another reachable span. We therefore use one-to-one
maximum-weight bipartite matching, allowing each emission and each gold
span to participate in at most one credited pair.

blocks.en: 4.2 Pricing emissions and missed spans
blocks.zh: 4.2 定价排放和漏报跨度

blocks.en: The parameters γ \gamma and β \beta control the two complementary errors. The coefficient γ \gamma increases the cost of unmatched emissions, while β \beta controls the relative emphasis placed on covering ground-truth spans. Increasing γ \gamma therefore favors a more conservative policy, whereas increasing β \beta places greater emphasis on recall. Exclusive matching also directly prices repeated responses. If multiple emissions compete for the same span, at most one can receive credit for that target; the others contribute to N out N_{\mathrm{out}} unless they are matched elsewhere. The matching retains the highest-value, or best-match assignment, allowing a genuinely improved response to replace a weaker one while charging for unnecessary retries. The reward therefore specifies not how often the model should speak, but how much value a new response must add.
blocks.zh: 参数 γ\gamma 和 β\β\β 控制两个互补错误. 系数 γ\gamma 增加了未匹配排放的成本,而β\β 控制了相对强调覆盖地面真相跨度。 因此,增加β\gamma更倾向于采取更保守的政策,而增加β\beta更强调召回。 完全匹配也是直接价格的重复答复。 如果多重排放量在同一阶段竞争,则最多一个可以获得该目标的入计量;其他排放量则为N型排放(NXXMThrm{outXXX)做出贡献,除非在其他地方与之相匹配。 匹配保留了最高值,或最匹配的任务,允许真正改进的响应,以取代较弱的响应,同时收取不必要的重试费. 因此,奖励没有规定模式应讲多少次,而是规定新对策必须增加多少价值。

blocks.en: Setup. The MMDuet2 SFT checkpoint is not publicly released, so we reproduce it from the published recipe with Qwen2.5-VL-3B [ 1 ] initialization. From this checkpoint we run GRPO [ 9 ] with VeRL [ 10 ] and SGLang on MMDuet2’s RL data for one epoch, changing only the reward; the in-reward judge is Qwen2.5-32B at temperature 0, and we set w fmt = 0.1 w_{\mathrm{fmt}}{=}0.1 and w span = 1 w_{\mathrm{span}}{=}1 . We report two configurations: γ = 1.5 \gamma{=}1.5 , which charges out-of-span emissions more than in-span ones, and β = 1.5 \beta{=}1.5 , an F β F_{\beta} reward with soft span membership (Sec. 4 ). The baseline is the released MMDuet2 checkpoint [ 12 ] . We also run the released MMDuet [ 14 ] and VideoLLM-Online [ 2 ] . We evaluate on the visual subset of OmniPro [ 19 ] and on ProactiveVideoQA [ 13 ] . For both, timing precision, recall and F1 use one-to-one matching between replies and gold answers; N p ​ r ​ e ​ d / N g ​ t N_{pred}/N_{gt} counts replies per gold answer.

blocks.en: Results on OmniPro. OmniPro annotates each answer as a point trigger; a reply matches a trigger within 3 s. To score what a reply says as well as when, we define F1 = c 2 S c / ( N p ​ r ​ e ​ d + N g ​ t ) {}_{c}=2S_{c}/(N_{pred}+N_{gt}) , where S c S_{c} sums a GPT-4.1 content score (0, 0.5 or 1, against the trigger’s reference answer) over matched pairs; timing F1 is the case where every match scores 1. Table 1 shows two opposite ways a proactive model can fail. VideoLLM-Online almost never replies and recovers 1.0% of triggers. MMDuet replies 5.39 times per trigger and reaches the highest recall (0.738), but only 13.7% of its replies match a trigger. Our policies sit between these extremes. The β \beta policy replies 1.63 times per trigger, 2.5 × \times fewer than MMDuet2 and 3.3 × \times fewer than MMDuet, and achieves the highest timing F1 (0.396) and content F1 c (0.154) of all models. The γ \gamma policy replies 0.71 times per trigger with the highest precision (0.418), above even the nearly silent VideoLLM-Online (0.395). F1 c improves along with timing F1, so the remaining replies are both better placed and more often correct. MMDuet2 reaches higher recall than either policy by generating more responses to cover each trigger, while β \beta retains 80% of that recall with 40% of the replies.

blocks.en: Results on ProactiveVideoQA. We report PAUC and repetition (Rep%) with MMDuet2’s released scorer and a GPT-4.1 judge, where Rep% is the fraction of repetitive replies, averaged over spans. PAUC integrates the best answer given within each span and, as Sec. 3 argues, cannot observe reply volume. Table 2 shows this with the baselines. On EGO, MMDuet ranks second on PAUC (43.6) while replying 16.9 times per gold answer, yet second-lowest on F1. On VAD, its 29 replies per answer score 23.1 PAUC, below the 25 a silent model receives. Our reward does not simply suppress replies. On EGO, where MMDuet2 replies only 0.54 times per gold answer and stays silent on 39.6% of videos, our policies reply 0.79–1.72 times per answer and raise F1 from 0.248 to 0.419, the highest of all models; γ \gamma improves every column over MMDuet2 while speaking more, and β \beta attains the highest PAUC on both EGO (46.0) and TV (47.0). On TV and VAD, β \beta is comparable to MMDuet2 in F1; on WEB it trails: WEB’s gold spans cover 81% of video time, so a reply at a random moment already lands in a span 81% of the time, and dense firing costs almost nothing. Interval annotation at this density leaves little room for a reward that prices replies. Hence, OmniPro’s point triggers serve as our primary test.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusions
blocks.zh: 6. 结论

blocks.en: We show that over-emission in proactive video assistants can arise from reward design rather than failed optimization. We identify a general failure mode in PAUC-based objectives, where additional predictions can improve reward without a count-dependent cost, and address it with an emission-aware F1 reward using exclusive span–emission matching. On OmniPro, our policy reduces emissions by 82.5% while raising precision from 0.161 to 0.418 and F1 from 0.259 to 0.346. Limitations include intra-span timing and manually chosen γ \gamma and β \beta , which future work can derive from deployment-specific costs.
blocks.zh: 我们显示,主动视频助理的过多排放可能来自奖励设计而不是失败优化。 在基于PAUC的目标中,我们确定了一种一般的失败模式,即额外的预测可以在不依赖计数成本的情况下提高奖励,并用完全跨度-排放比对的认识到F1奖励来处理。 在OmniPro方面,我们的政策是将排放量减少82.5%,同时将精度从0.161提高到0.418,F1从0.259提高到0.346。 限制包括空间内部时间和人工选择的γ\gamma和β\beta,未来工作可以来自部署特定费用。
